caption: The drawing depicts two ceramic vessels, both rendered in varying shades of brown, with one being prominent and centrally placed while the other, a smaller and slimmer bottle, appears in the upper right corner. The main object is a large, cylindrical jug with a single curved handle affixed to its shoulder. This jug features a conical, tapering top and a short, circular neck with a small mouth. The jug is decorated on the upper section with an ornate floral motif directly above the words "TROY, N.Y. POTTERY." A row of small, round dots encircles the vessel just below its sloped shoulder. The brown surface of the jug displays various lighter and darker patches, indicative of reflections and uneven glazing. The slim bottle at the top right is similarly colored and vertically oriented, displaying alternating lighter and darker brown sections, a narrow neck, and a small mouth, and is decorated with a similar dotted border around its shoulder. The drawing is framed by a thin, rectangular outline and is set against a plain, off-white background. In the lower left corner outside the outlined border, the artist’s signature "Chas. Cason" is visible.
title: Bottle
